notes: Every file that CALLS emit() from the in-process event bus. Files that only subscribe(), or that declare/label event names, are excluded; src/lib/event-bus.ts is included because it calls emit() itself. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts (ts-morph over corpus/taskflow/tsconfig.json); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. tests/** is excluded from every key: the tasks ask about application code, and a spec that merely exercises a symbol is not a place the behaviour lives.
